comparison_method: Read the actual frozen JSON files; compare object values and each existing rule by exact id. Policy-file SHA256 authenticates original bytes; canonical object hashes below only identify the documented JSON values and are not the effective-policy normalization hash.
completion_status: This auxiliary comparison does not read or decide in-progress formal scan results.

provenance.note: Document and source selectors are locators only. No expected clauses, paths, predicates or comparison result is configured.

conditions: Selected document bytes, CST declarations and source bindings are authenticated in the same saved snapshot.
Selected Device composition, fallible prefixes and deferred callbacks reach the recorded source operations normally; this is a source-model comparison.
counterexamples: Control Plane-internal uniqueness is not automatically a whole-project claim; Device and Server deployment scopes remain distinct.
Long-term credential lifetime, external provider success and actual secret contents remain unknown. Typed model-stream messages may still be used by a Device-local path.
